assumptions.statement: Official precise boundaries, regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage controls, municipal capacity, and engineering conditions are unavailable in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are provisional design-model outputs; statutory and engineering conclusions are excluded.

assumptions.statement: When official site or key-area polygons arrive, regenerate all nine geometry layers, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs together.
assumptions.impact: Do not replace a single displayed number without rebuilding the complete evidence chain.

assumptions.statement: Teach-Back courses, forums, receipts, and drills are operating references, not confirmed government programmes, budgets, or procurement commitments.
assumptions.impact: Each activity requires an accountable operator, accessibility review, rights clearance, and safety approval before use.
